scoring_justification: The transition strain rate is an analytic function of published material parameters; the checker can recompute it from the agent's reported conditions (d, R, material, temperature). A direct recompute-and-compare within tolerance, plus structural trend verification, forms a strong T1 check.

outputs.description: CSV file containing the ductile-to-brittle transition strain rate computed for all required combinations of grain size, confinement, material, and temperature.

output_contract.notes: The verifier recomputes the formula with the same parameters, compares each row within relative tolerance, and checks monotonic trends across rows.
